name: 03032 · Auburn, NH
findings: ZIP 03032 (Auburn) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03032 (Auburn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 03032 (Auburn) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
